messages:
Maria (CS): FYI Zephyr is seeing a burst of 429s during onboarding warmup. They spin up a bunch of containers and each one hits /auth/refresh at the same time.
Zephyr Support: Here's the header from our logs: `POST /auth/refresh 429 {"error": "rate_exceeded"}`. Happens ~10s after deploy.
Maria (CS): Happening during the SDK init path when their service starts multiple workers. Not actual traffic yet, just warmup.
Devon (Eng): Do we have exact timing? is it the SDK calling refresh immediately on start?
Zephyr Support: Yes — each process calls client.refreshToken() in startup hook. No jitter.
Alex (SDK): Ah — classic stampede. SDK defaults to immediate refresh on init if token TTL < 30s. If multiple processes boot, they all refresh.
Priya (Onboard): Quick question for workaround while we patch — can they reuse the host-level token or put a shared cache?
Zephyr Support: They can modify runtime but prefer a config change rather than code.
Devon (Eng): Short-term we can add a debounce option to SDK config and recommend env var. Long-term maybe smart leader election for refresh.
Alex (SDK): I can push a micro-patch today with `token_refresh_debounce_ms` and `refresh_jitter_pct`. Patch example: ```json
{
  "token_refresh_debounce_ms": 2500,
  "refresh_jitter_pct": 0.15
}
```
Alex (SDK): Behavior: first process does the refresh, others wait up to debounce + jitter then recheck TTL. Should cut concurrent refresh attempts.
Devon (Eng): Also adding an in-memory filelock option helps when containers share a host fs. `SDK_CACHE_LOCK=/tmp/zephyr_sdk.lock`
Priya (Onboard): I'll send step-by-step to Zephyr: set env `REDWOOD_SDK_REFRESH_DEBOUNCE=2500` and `REDWOOD_SDK_REFRESH_JITTER=0.15` then restart.
Zephyr Support: Can you also suggest a short server-side tolerance? We saw some failures even with slightly staggered refreshes.
Devon (Eng): We can extend token grace window on `/auth/refresh` to accept overlapping requests for 5s to accommodate jitter. SRE: @DeployBot can we try a small config flip in staging?
DeployBot: Deploy triggered for auth-service config -> increased refresh-grace=5s by priya.config-change. Build #3187.
DeployBot: ✅ rollout to staging completed (auth-service v2.1.3-grace). No errors in smoke tests.
Zephyr Support: Ok applied env vars and restarted 4 workers. Observed only 1 refresh per pod, a few retries but no 429s.
Maria (CS): Great — can we make the SDK change a patch in the next minor so other customers don't hit this?
Alex (SDK): Yep I'll open PR with tests for debounce and jitter. Link when ready.
Priya (Onboard): I'll follow up with Zephyr tomorrow to confirm production ramp. Marking this thread as resolved for now. :white_check_mark:
Zephyr Support: Thanks everyone — appreciate the quick help.
Maria (CS): Noted for renewal risk: was looking risky during warmup but now mitigated. I'll update account health doc with notes and recommended SDK confi guration.
Devon (Eng): Leaving a playback in our runbook under "auth stampede" with sample configs + deploy steps.
Alex (SDK): PR: will include a short migration note: recommend `token_refresh_debounce_ms` for multi-process startups.
Priya (Onboard): Closing loop with Zephyr and scheduling a 30-min post-mortem if they want.
Maria (CS): thanks all.
